questions.statement: Which of the following underline words is written in the passive voice?

options.text: At time of writing, there was a lack of other active websites.
The aim of this blog is to provide a home for articles and new research on Hodgson.
2027 will see the 150th anniversary of William Hope Hodgson’s birth.
Sam Gafford sadly passed away in 2019, leaving his site dormant.
My hope is that others may be moved to contribute also.

questions.explanation: Em “others may be moved to contribute”, a estrutura “may + be + particípio” expressa voz passiva: outras pessoas podem ser motivadas a colaborar. As demais orações usam construções ativas, copulativas ou existenciais.

options.text: I entered into brief correspondence with Sam at that time.
New research on Hodgson, details of Hodgson- related happenings
Findings I’ve been meaning to write up.
The aim of this blog is to provide a resource for anyone interested in the life and work of William Hope Hodgson
By providing this site others may be moved to contribute their own thoughts and research

questions.explanation: “Entered” é passado simples de “enter” e apresenta uma ação concluída em época determinada. Já “I’ve been meaning” usa present perfect continuous; as demais expressões contêm substantivos, formas presentes ou construção modal passiva.

According to the Brazilian document “Base Nacional Comum Curricular” (BNCC), regarding English as a lingua franca, select the correct alternative.

options.text: Although the BNCC acknowledges the global use of English, it maintains that the language should be taught in accordance with the standardized norms of native speakers from hegemonic countries, in order to ensure international intelligibility.

While recognizing certain sociolinguistic variations, the BNCC recommends privileging native varieties—particularly British and American English—so as to preserve linguistic accuracy and cultural prestige in the classroom.

The BNCC views English as a culturally neutral tool, which should be taught without attention to the sociocultural backgrounds of its speakers, focusing primarily on grammatical structures common to standardized exams.

The BNCC promotes an understanding of English as a dynamic and context-dependent lingua franca, thus legitimizing its diverse uses by speakers from various linguistic and cultural backgrounds across the globe.
Given the need for linguistic consistency in education, the BNCC encourages teachers to adopt one recognized English variety as a fixed model, regardless of the multilingual realities of learners.

questions.explanation: A BNCC trata o inglês como língua franca, reconhecendo usos diversos e situados de falantes multiculturais. Por isso, rejeita a imposição de padrões britânico ou estadunidense e a ideia de idioma culturalmente neutro, uniforme ou alheio aos contextos de uso.

A Brazilian English teacher has been hired to teach a group of experienced doctors who are preparing for a professional development program in an English-speaking country. These professionals will mainly need to understand technical literature in their field and participate in conferences. In relation to the scenario presented and the principles of English for Specific Purposes (ESP), it is correct to state that:

options.text: general English instruction is more appropriate in this context, as it prevents the complexity of adapting lessons to learners’ professional goals.
ESP teaching disregards learners’ prior language knowledge and focuses only on technical vocabulary.
teaching ESP to professionals from the same field limits collaborative learning and should be averted.
the teacher should conduct a needs analysis to align language instruction with the learners’ communicative demands and specific contexts of use.
ESP classes should keep away from authentic materials, as they may confuse learners and demotivate them.

questions.explanation: No inglês para fins específicos, a análise de necessidades identifica tarefas reais, como ler artigos médicos e participar de congressos. O ensino deve aproveitar conhecimentos prévios e materiais autênticos, em vez de reduzir-se a vocabulário técnico ou inglês genérico.
